reading.body:
H.R. 8283 is a Republican-carried AI model theft bill with exactly one Democratic cosponsor out of twenty, and the lobbying it attracted came from trade associations and Meta rather than a broad corporate field.

The cosponsor list is the clearest signal in the data. Bill Huizenga sponsors, and of the nineteen cosponsors recorded, eighteen are Republicans. Sydney Kamlager-Dove and Josh Gottheimer are the only Democrats. A bill tagged to national security and exports, framed around deterring theft of American AI models, has drawn support that is almost entirely one-party. That is a narrower coalition than the subject matter alone would predict.

Six lobbying filings from 2025 or later name the bill. Two come from FDD Action, a hawkish national security outfit. The rest come from the Information Technology Industry Council, the Software and Information Industry Association, and Meta Platforms. The trade associations represent the large model developers and software vendors who would be regulated or protected by an export-control-style theft statute. Meta is the one named model developer in the filings. The data records that these organizations named the bill as an issue in their lobbying. It does not record what position any of them took.

What this does not cover is the bill's substance. There is no text of the provisions, no committee action, no recorded votes, and no outcome. The status date is 2026-04-15, and the page was built in October 2026, so the record stops well short of any floor consideration. Nothing here speaks to compute, data centers, or power. The bill concerns model weights and export exposure, which is a software and legal question, not a grid question. The lobbying counts are also small, six filings total, so they show who showed up rather than who is spending at scale.

summary: H.R. 8283, Deterring American AI Model Theft Act of 2026. Latest status date 2026-04-15. Issues tagged from the bill's own text: national security and exports. 6 lobbying filing(s) for 2025 or later name it.
